author: Pete Yanity
title: Four area games moved from Friday up to Thursday in the High School Red Zone - NewsBreak
text:
By Pete Yanity ,
10 hours ago
Four games involving area teams have been moved up to Thursday from Friday due to potential bad weather.
Polk Co. at Chase, Thursday, 7:30pm
Eastside at Chapman, Thursday, 7:30pm
Abbeville at Saluda, Thursday, 7:30pm
Ninety Six at Mid Carolina, 7:30pm
Westside's game at Ashley Ridge has been pushed back to an 8pm kick-off Friday.
No other games have been moved as of midday Wednesday following a check of other area schools that have home games scheduled.
